criteria.criterion: Inspect exactly the first 30 front-page stories (or clearly report inability)

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows stories numbered 1–23 (23 partially). Screenshot 2 shows stories numbered 11–30 and the footer. Combined, the screenshots cover items 1–30, though not all in one view.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Although the agent did not enumerate each story in the final answer, the screenshots substantiate that the first 30 stories were viewable/inspected across the scroll (1–23 in Screenshot 1, and 24–30 visible in Screenshot 2, with 11–23 overlapping). This is sufficient to support that the agent could inspect exactly the first 30 without going beyond 30. Award full credit.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Latest DOM is state 1: the story list includes items numbered up to 30 and shows #1, #2, then jumps to #8 through #30; items #3–#7 are not present in the provided DOM snapshot. Earlier DOM (state 0) shows #1–#26 only. There is no DOM evidence that #3–#7 were inspected.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Only partial support that the agent inspected exactly the first 30 stories: the evidence does show many within 1–30 (including #30), but it does not explicitly include #3–#7, so a complete inspection of #1–#30 cannot be confirmed under the DOM rule. Baseline score remains appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Identify GitHub-linked stories among the 30 (count + titles)
criteria.description: Count github.com-linked stories among the first 30 and list their titles.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: In Screenshot 1, item #20 is titled “I-have-ADHD: A skill to stop coding agents from burying the answer” with domain shown as (github.com/ayghri). No other visible domains in Screenshot 1 are github.com. In Screenshot 2 (latest), among items 11–30, only item #20 shows a github.com domain; the rest are other domains.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s count (1) and the listed GitHub-linked title match the visual evidence across the inspected top-30 range. Since items 1–30 are covered across the screenshots and only #20 is marked with a github.com domain, full credit is warranted.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Latest DOM is state 1: among the visible items within the first-30 numbering shown (#1–#2 and #8–#30), exactly one row shows a github.com domain: #20 "I-have-ADHD: A skill to stop coding agents from burying the answer" with source "github.com/ayghri". The DOM does not show #3–#7, so it cannot confirm whether additional GitHub-linked stories exist there.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s listed GitHub-linked title (#20) is supported by the DOM. However, the agent’s claimed total count of 1 across the full top 30 is not fully verifiable because #3–#7 are missing from the evidence; additional github.com links cannot be ruled out. Award partial credit for correctly identifying at least one GitHub-linked story and providing its title, but not full credit for the overall count completeness.
